name: Saotome Reo
source:
Saotome Reo is a graduate student from Hakuou Academy majoring in Pedagogy, and turns up from time to time on the school grounds around Makoto and his friends for research purposes.

He is cool, collected, and quite striking in appearance, and seems to have a firm set of goals that he's working towards.

[From English patch notes]
